evidence.description: ISO8601DateFormatter is instantiated every time lastUpdatedDate() is called.

candidates.explanation: Creating a date formatter is an expensive operation. It should be reused as a static property or a private property to improve performance, especially when processing multiple results in a loop.
candidates.title: Inefficient Date Formatter Instantiation

evidence.description: The second element of the tuple returned by urlSession.data(from:) is prefixed with an underscore, indicating it is unused.

candidates.explanation: While using an underscore is a common way to ignore a return value, it is worth noting that the response status or other metadata from the network request is being explicitly discarded.
candidates.title: Unused Variable

candidates.explanation: The actor initializes its state with hardcoded magic numbers and dates. This makes the initial state of the singleton difficult to maintain and less flexible for different environments.
candidates.title: Hardcoded Data
